title: VerifyDoc
description: Verify v1, the report of `lodwright verify --json`.

contract.description: The contract name, `lodwright-verify`: a reader refuses a document that names another.

correlation.description:
With a reference: the per-channel correlation of the terrain diffuse (and normal map) of every block present
on both sides with the reference's. Omitted without a reference.

differences.description: Differences from the reference folder; empty when no reference was given.

errors.description: What is wrong with the folder, sorted by path.

known.description:
With `--known-differences`: the differences the list names, with its reason and release. They are reported
and do not make the run fail. Omitted when empty.

objects.description:
With a reference: every object block present on both sides, compared with the reference's. Omitted without
a reference.

ok.description: True when the folder has no errors.

stale.description:
With `--known-differences`: listed paths that no longer differ, so the list can lose them. Omitted when
empty.

terrain.description:
With a reference: the terrain heights of every block present on both sides, compared with the reference's.
Omitted without a reference.

water.description:
With a reference: the water of every terrain block that has water on either side, compared with the
reference's. Omitted without a reference.

Channels.description: A Pearson correlation per colour channel, from -1 to 1, rounded to three decimals.

CorrelationBlock.description: The texture correlation of one terrain block.

diffuse.description: The correlation of the diffuse texture.

normals.description: The correlation of the normal map; omitted when it is missing on a side or cannot be compared.

path.description: The diffuse texture, relative to the folder, lower case.

CorrelationLevel.description: The texture correlation of one terrain level.

diffuse.description: The diffuse textures of this level.

normals.description: The normal maps of this level; omitted when none could be compared.

CorrelationReport.description:
The Pearson correlation per colour channel between the terrain textures of the blocks present on both sides and
the reference's, over the pixels of the decoded images (alpha is not compared). Two flat channels correlate as 1
when they hold the same value and 0 otherwise; a flat channel against a varying one is 0. A pair whose size
differs, or that cannot be decoded, is left out. Numbers are rounded to three decimals.

blocks.description: Blocks whose diffuse textures were compared.

diffuse.description: The summary of all compared diffuse textures; omitted when none was compared.

normals.description: The summary of all compared normal maps; omitted when none was compared.

per_block.description: Every compared block, sorted by path.

per_level.description: The same summaries per terrain level, smallest level first. Omitted when no block was compared.

CorrelationSummary.description: The correlations of a set of blocks: the mean and the lowest per channel.

lowest.description: The lowest correlation of any block, per channel.

mean.description: The mean of the blocks' correlations, per channel.

KnownDifference.description: A difference the known-differences list names.

path.description: The file, relative to the folder, forward slashes.

problem.description: What differs, as prose for people; never matched on.

reason.description: Why the difference is accepted, from the list.

release.description: The release expected to remove it, from the list.

ObjectBlock.description: One object block compared with the reference's.

exact.description: Equal counts and no unmatched vertex.

path.description: The block mesh, relative to the folder, lower case.

unmatched_vertices.description: Vertices of the block with no vertex of the reference's block within 0.05 units.

vertices.description: Vertices of the block (all its shapes).

ObjectReport.description:
The object blocks compared with the reference. A block is exact when the vertex and triangle counts are equal and
every vertex lies within 0.05 units of a vertex of the reference's block, in any order. Not being exact is reported,
not a finding.

blocks.description: Object blocks present on both sides.

per_block.description: Every block present on both sides, sorted by path.

TerrainBlock.description: The height difference of one terrain block.

max.description: The largest absolute height difference, in game units.

mean.description: The mean absolute height difference, in game units.

path.description: The block mesh, relative to the folder, lower case.

TerrainLevel.description: The terrain heights of one level compared with the reference.

blocks.description: Blocks of this level that were compared.

max.description: The largest difference of the level, in game units.

mean.description: The mean of the blocks' mean differences, in game units.

over_tolerance.description: Of those, the blocks whose largest difference is over the tolerance.

TerrainReport.description:
The terrain heights of the blocks compared with the reference: the ground of both meshes sampled on a 33 by 33
grid over the bounds of the block, at the points both cover, as the absolute difference of the heights in game
units. Numbers are rounded to three decimals.

blocks.description: Terrain blocks compared (present on both sides and sharing sampled ground).

max.description: The largest difference of any block; omitted when no block was compared.

mean.description: The mean of the blocks' mean differences; omitted when no block was compared.

over_tolerance.description: Blocks whose largest difference is over `tolerance`.

per_block.description: Every compared block, sorted by path.

per_level.description: The same numbers per terrain level, smallest level first. Omitted when no block was compared.

tolerance.description: The largest difference over which a block counts in `over_tolerance`: `--height-tolerance`, or 1 without it.

VerifyFinding.description: One finding: a file and what is wrong with it, or how it differs from the reference.

path.description: The file, relative to the folder, forward slashes.

problem.description: What is wrong, as prose for people; never matched on.

WaterBlock.description: The water `IoU` of one terrain block.

iou.description: 1 for the same covered ground, 0 for none in common.

path.description: The block mesh, relative to the folder, lower case.

WaterLevel.description: The water of one terrain level compared with the reference.

blocks.description: Blocks of this level with water on either side.

under_threshold.description: Of those, the blocks under the threshold.

WaterProfileLevel.description: The shape of the water of one terrain level compared with the reference: means over the blocks with water.

blocks.description: Blocks of this level with water on either side.

depth_mine.description: Mean of the highest minus the lowest water vertex of a block, in world units (0 for flat planes): lodwright's.

height_agreement.description:
Mean, over the blocks where the two cover ground in common, of the share of those cells whose top surface
heights differ by at most 1 unit; omitted when no block has cells in common.

vertices_mine.description: Mean number of water vertices a block carries in the file (every water shape but the empty one): lodwright's.

wall_mine.description:
Mean area of the steep triangles of a block (the walls and slopes at the edge of the water; seen from above they
cover less than a thousandth of their own area), in square world units: lodwright's.

WaterReport.description:
The water of the terrain blocks compared with the reference: the `IoU` (intersection over union) of the ground the
two water planes cover, seen from above, sampled at the centres of a 400 by 400 grid over the bounds of both
planes. Numbers are rounded to three decimals.

blocks.description: Terrain blocks with water on either side (and present on both sides).

lowest.description: The lowest `IoU`; omitted when no block has water.

mean.description: The mean `IoU`; omitted when no block has water.

per_block.description: Every block with water, sorted by path.

per_level.description:
The same numbers per terrain level, smallest level first: what the release notes list. Omitted when no
block has water.

profile.description:
The shape of the water beyond the covered ground, per terrain level (sloped edges, how far down the water
reaches, agreement of heights), smallest level first. Omitted when no block has water.

threshold.description: The `IoU` under which a block counts in `under_threshold`: `--water-iou`, or 0.95 without it.
